component: Main mail-window stylesheet loading and platform skin packaging

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original removal replaces the wrapper link with four direct stylesheet links and relocates shared and platform rules into their receiving stylesheets. The platform package maps retain other destination-to-source values while the wrapper registrations disappear. Selected moved blocks match exactly, but their new load position and the deleted messengerBox background rules prevent a whole-cascade equivalence claim. The fixed accepted head later omits folderPane.css, and Windows selectors/theme values also have later changes. Keep the original move, later source and historical reviewers' visual reports separate.
title: Removing mailWindow1 makes stylesheet loading explicit without proving cascade equivalence
